text: ProgramDescription Chinese and western medicine clinical medical professional training to master Chinese materia medica and traditional Chinese medicine resources to learn the basic theory, basic knowledge and basic skills, can in all kinds of traditional Chinese medicine and Chinese medicine resources, research and development institutions, colleges and universities, pharmaceutical companies, circulation, and administrative departments and other units engaged in traditional Chinese medicine research, development, scientific research, comprehensive utilization of resources, production and processing, quality control, marketing and management of senior Chinese medicine resources, specialized personnel. Duration 3 years
